school.tagged_body:
Today, I taught English to a six-year-old boy.
He worked hard in the {{v:lesson}} and followed the activities well. So I gave him a {{v:sticker}}.
We have a simple rule. {{g:If he collects three stickers|조건을 나타내는 If절: '만약 ~한다면'}}, he can {{t:choose something fun for the next lesson}}.
Today, he got his third sticker.
I thought he would choose a game or a small {{v:prize}}. But he happily said that he wanted to play a zombie game.
For a moment, I thought I had made a big {{v:mistake}}.
Then something surprising happened. His mother was sitting quietly next to us. She said she would join the game too. She said she would become a zombie.
So next week, a six-year-old zombie and his mother are going to chase me while I teach English.
I am not sure how much English we will study that day.
But I have to say that I am a little {{v:excited}} about it.

prestudy.tagged_body:
Today, I found myself teaching English to a six-year-old boy, one of the most {{v:energetic}} students I have ever taught.
{{g:Because he had worked hard throughout the lesson and had followed every activity with surprising focus|과거완료(had + p.p.): 보상을 받기 전에 이미 끝난 일을 나타냄}}, I rewarded him with a sticker. We follow a simple rule in class: once he collects three stickers, he is allowed to choose something enjoyable for the following lesson.
Today, much to his delight, he finally earned his third sticker.
Naturally, I assumed he would ask for a video game or perhaps a small toy. Instead, grinning from ear to ear, he announced that what he truly wanted was to play a zombie game.
For a brief, {{v:unsettling}} moment, it occurred to me that I might have made a rather serious mistake in agreeing to such a rule.
What happened next made the situation even more {{v:entertaining}}. His mother, {{g:who had been sitting quietly beside us the entire time|계속적 용법의 관계대명사 who: 앞의 명사(His mother)에 대한 추가 설명}}, unexpectedly {{v:volunteered}} to join in. Smiling, she declared that she, too, would transform into a zombie for the occasion.
As a result, next week I am expected to teach an English lesson while being chased around the room by a six-year-old zombie and his equally enthusiastic mother.
{{t:Whether much English will actually be learned that day remains uncertain.}}
Even so, I must confess that, strangely enough, I find myself looking forward to it more than I probably should.

questions.explanation: 'Whether much English will actually be learned that day remains uncertain.'과 일치한다.

questions.q: How does the writer feel about the situation in the final sentence?
choices: He finds himself looking forward to it more than he probably should
questions.answer: He finds himself looking forward to it more than he probably should
questions.explanation: 'I find myself looking forward to it more than I probably should.'와 일치한다.

questions.q: Because he had worked hard throughout the lesson and had followed every activity with surprising ____, I rewarded him with a sticker.
questions.explanation: 'with surprising focus'에서 확인할 수 있다.

questions.q: Instead, grinning from ear to ear, he announced that what he truly wanted was to play a ____ game.
questions.explanation: 'to play a zombie game'에서 확인할 수 있다.

questions.q: For a brief, unsettling moment, it occurred to me that I might have made a rather serious ____.
questions.explanation: 'a rather serious mistake'에서 확인할 수 있다.

questions.q: Smiling, she declared that she, too, would ____ into a zombie for the occasion.
questions.explanation: 'would transform into a zombie'에서 확인할 수 있다.

questions.q: Even so, I must confess that, strangely enough, I find myself looking forward to it more than I probably ____.
questions.explanation: 'more than I probably should'에서 확인할 수 있다.

questions.q: The boy's mother volunteered to join the game unexpectedly.
questions.explanation: 'unexpectedly volunteered to join in'과 일치한다.

questions.q: The writer is completely certain that a lot of English will be learned that day.
questions.explanation: 'Whether much English will actually be learned that day remains uncertain.'이라고 했으므로 사실이 아니다.

questions.q: The boy asked for a video game or a small toy.
questions.explanation: 그것은 글쓴이가 그럴 것이라고 짐작한 것일 뿐, 아이는 실제로 좀비 게임을 원했으므로 사실이 아니다.

items: Instead, grinning from ear to ear, he announced that what he truly wanted was to play a zombie game.
His mother, who had been sitting quietly beside us the entire time, unexpectedly volunteered to join in.
Because he had worked hard throughout the lesson and had followed every activity with surprising focus, I rewarded him with a sticker.
Today, much to his delight, he finally earned his third sticker.
answer: Because he had worked hard throughout the lesson and had followed every activity with surprising focus, I rewarded him with a sticker.
Today, much to his delight, he finally earned his third sticker.
Instead, grinning from ear to ear, he announced that what he truly wanted was to play a zombie game.
His mother, who had been sitting quietly beside us the entire time, unexpectedly volunteered to join in.

questions.q: What does the underlined word 'volunteered' mean in this passage?
questions.explanation: 'volunteered'는 '자원했다'라는 뜻이다. 'unexpectedly volunteered to join in'에서 확인할 수 있다.

essays.q: Why does the writer describe the moment as 'unsettling'? Answer in English.
essays.sampleAnswer: Because he suddenly worried that agreeing to the sticker rule might have been a serious mistake.
essays.rubric: 규칙에 동의한 것이 심각한 실수일 수 있다는 걱정을 서술하면 만점

essays.q: Explain in English what the boy's mother volunteered to do and why it made the situation more entertaining.
essays.sampleAnswer: She volunteered to become a zombie too, which made the situation even more entertaining and unexpected.
essays.rubric: 엄마도 좀비가 되기로 자원했고 그로 인해 상황이 더 재미있어졌다는 내용 포함시 만점

essays.q: 우리말로 쓰시오: 글쓴이가 다음 주에 하기로 되어 있는 일은 무엇인가요?
essays.sampleAnswer: 방 안을 돌아다니며 여섯 살짜리 좀비와 그의 엄마에게 쫓기면서 영어 수업을 해야 한다.
essays.rubric: 쫓기면서 수업을 해야 한다는 내용이 들어가면 만점

essays.q: How does the writer feel about the upcoming lesson, according to the last two sentences? Write in English.
essays.sampleAnswer: He is uncertain about how much will be learned, but he strangely finds himself looking forward to it.
essays.rubric: 불확실함과 동시에 이상하게 기대된다는 감정 둘 다 서술하면 만점

essays.q: 우리말로 쓰시오: 이 글에서 예상치 못한 전개(twist)는 무엇인가요? 자신의 말로 서술하시오.
essays.sampleAnswer: 아이가 상품이 아니라 좀비 게임을 하고 싶어했고, 조용히 있던 엄마까지 좀비가 되겠다고 자원한 것이 예상치 못한 전개이다.
essays.rubric: 아이의 선택과 엄마의 자원 참여라는 두 가지 의외의 전개를 언급하면 만점
